subject: [PATCH 10/16] selftests/mm: verify synchronous khugepaged driving is attributable

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new selftest, khugepaged_sync_check, to verify that synchronous khugepaged driving is attributable. The test uses the huge_memory tracepoints to attribute per-attempt outcomes and checks that exactly one attempt is attributed for each step of the test. The test prepares aligned windows, records source PFNs, runs khugepaged_full_pass() barriers, and requires the window to be collapsed with exactly one attributed attempt. The patch also adds minimal tracefs helpers to vm_util to enable and clear event subsystems and open the trace buffer.
